Hi. I've formalized the Atkinson–Lloyd theorem on large spaces of matrices of bounded rank, together with the Flanders inequality it refines, in Lean 4 + Mathlib (sorry-free, only the three standard axioms).

Is any of this area already in Mathlib or in progress? I'd be happy to work on PRing pieces of this if there's interest.

The main results are:

  • flanders_le_of_lt_card: if every matrix in a linear subspace V ⊆ Mₙ(K) has rank ≤ r and #K > r, then dim V ≤ n · r.
  • atkinson_lloyd_of_lt_card: under the same hypotheses, if dim V > n·r − r + 1, then V is a compression space (all matrices share a common (n−r)-dimensional null space, or the same holds for the transposed space).

The repo is at https://github.com/jarfo/atkinson-lloyd — it builds against leanprover/lean4:v4.33.0-rc1 and Mathlib v4.33.0-rc1.
